component.name: Epic Games Launcher
component.summary: Download, install, and play games from the Epic Games Store

description.p: The Epic Games Launcher is the gateway to all content on the Epic Games store. Install games from your Epic Games account, browse the store, or manage Unreal Engine installations.
**AI Disclosure**: Epic Games is claiming the launcher is "vibecoded" (without offering details on what they mean). This Flatpak package is community-maintained, no AI was used in its creation.

screenshot.caption: The "Library" tab, showing a lot of installed games, along with the social panel on the right
The game details pop-up, visible after clicking a game in the library
The "Store" tab, prominently showing the banner of a recently released game
The "Develop" tab, where Unreal Engine installations and related tools can be installed

description.p: Plugin updates will now be shown and can be applied in the Plugins menu, in the Develop tab.
Your Develop tab's grid or list view choices will now be saved in your per-account preferences.
The "Go to store page" option in your Library now opens the associated game store page.
Launching an add-on did not first queue an update when its parent game was out of date.
Offline searches of your Fab library did not apply the selected format filter or sort order.
Closing the installer window during an install will now cancel the install and roll it back.
Keyboard navigation will now work in the Library grid view.
Games whose install folder had been deleted still appeared in the Library.
The Social Panel can now be collapsed.
A Switch account option is now available in the launcher.
Dev and Stage sandbox builds will now be labeled in the Library, as in the Legacy Epic Games launcher.
The open filter panel in the Library did not cover the header row.
The Social Panel sometimes wasn't restored after being signed out of Epic Online Services.
Clicking Install twice in quick succession could start a second install of the same game.
The list in the Library sometimes became unresponsive while an arrow key was held down.
Opening Fab's plugin search for an Unreal Engine version will now filter the results to that engine version.
Linux: A locked system keyring previously could have blocked the launcher from starting or would have signed you out.
Linux: The chat notification setting was not being recognized.
On occasion, the Library, catalog, and cover images failed to load on slower networks.
A game and owned DLC will now be installed together as a single install operation.
Linux: Local Unreal Engine installs can now be opened from the launcher.
One-click installs did not follow the shortcut choice made in the install dialog.
The Library occasionally showed an incomplete list of games after an interrupted scan.
Unreleased games in the Library did not show as Unavailable when preloads were turned off.
A game with a pending update will now be updated before it launches.
A Plugins tab is now available in both the Unreal Engine install and manage-modules dialogs.
The footer of the What's New popup shown at startup could have appeared off-screen.
Motification quiet hours will now apply only to accounts under 18.
On macOS and Linux, the Social Panel will now show an error state when it fails to load.
The Library will now automatically refresh after you place an order from the Store.
In the Unreal Engine tab, tools with updates available will now keep the Launch button and show an update notification dot.
Certain games in the Library showed buttons that did nothing instead of showing their preload date.
A list view is now offered in the Unreal Engine module dialogs.
Downloads will now wait for the network to become available instead of failing.
The launcher will now check for game updates when you press Play and when a game closes.
Game updates failed when files were set to read-only.
A preload that had not yet opened was shown as incompatible in the Library instead of as a pre-order.
The Store showed a blank page when switching tabs.
A select-all toggle is now available for add-ons in the install options.
A spinner will now appear in the corner of the Store and Fab pages while the pages load.
The Play button in the Library used to differ in width between games.
The close button was sometimes hard to reach from the corner of a maximized window.
Uninstaller: You can now choose to keep your installed games when uninstalling the launcher.
Window dragging: Fixed a bug that could cause the launcher window to be undraggable.
Linux: Fixed a bug that could cause the Store, Fab, and the friends and chat panel to appear blank on Linux systems.
Downloads: Download progress in the bottom bar now updates more smoothly.
Localization: Arabic is now offered as a language option and is selected automatically on systems set to Arabic.
Unreal Engine: Fixed a bug that could cause Unreal Engine projects stored in some folders not to be found.
Sign in: Fixed a bug that could cause a signed-in session to be lost at startup if network connectivity was unavailable.
Library: Optional install components are now shown in the Manage dialog for supported games.
Self-update: The self-update screen now shows actual download progress.
Self-update: Fixed a bug that could cause the Store, Fab, and social panel to appear on top of the self-update screen.
Library: The Library now tells the user when a game is busy installing prerequisite packages.
Library: Fixed a bug that could cause the back and forward buttons to not behave correctly in the Library.
Unreal Engine: Fixed a bug that could cause .uproject files to not be associated correctly.
Unreal Engine: Fixed a bug that could cause installed engines to not be registered properly.
Updates: Fixed a bug that could cause the Restart and Update button to fail the first time it was clicked.
Downloads: Games that use encrypted builds can now be installed and played.
Feedback: When a feedback report is too large to send, the launcher now says so instead of reporting a network error.
Library: Fixed a bug that could cause some games to show the wrong artwork in the library.
Settings: Fixed a bug that hid the scheduled download time fields in Settings.
Store: Fixed a bug that could cause certain pages on the Store tab to show a black screen on Linux.
Sign-in: Fixed a bug that caused sign-in to fail after migrating from the old launcher.
Linux: Fixed a bug that could cause a blank window when opening the launcher from the Applmage package.
Game updates: Game updates now install faster.
Trailers: Trailer videos now pause when the launcher window isn't visible.
Checkout: Fixed a bug that caused the store checkout flow to hang after selecting a payment provider.
Downloads: Fixed a bug that could cause downloads to fail on systems with slower disks.
Downloads: Fixed a bug that could cause downloads to keep retrying while paused.
Downloads: Fixed a bug that could prevent a game from being uninstalled while it was updating.
Get started: The launcher now surfaces "Get started" offers that help you find and install Unreal Engine and UEFN.
Learn: The Learn section now links to Epic's sample projects on Fab.
Update splash screens: The splash screens shown during launcher updates now share a consistent look with a segmented progress bar.
Add to project: The Add to project list now includes engine versions that were installed through this launcher.
Downloads: Fixed a bug that could leave a game stuck in the wrong state on the Downloads page after a queued install or update failed.
Library: Total play time in the library now shows minutes in addition to hours.
Store: Fixed a bug that could cause certain links to open inside the launcher instead of your system browser.
Self-update: Fixed a bug that could leave window buttons unresponsive after the launcher relaunched itself in the background.
Library: Fixed a bug that could delay opening a pinned game.
Library: Fixed a bug that could cause keyboard focus to be lost when navigating between screens in the library.
Library: Fixed a bug that could prevent some installed titles from appearing under the Installed filter.
Top bar: The contents of the top bar can now be removed or reordered using a new right-click menu.
Updates: Fixed a bug that could cause updates to rewrite more files than necessary.
Accessibility: Fixed a bug that could allow keyboard focus to escape modal dialogs.
Downloads: Fixed a bug that could cause an update to appear stuck instead of showing as installing while it finished.
Top bar: When the top bar becomes too crowded, less-used items now overflow into a More menu.
Migration: Play history is now preserved during migration from a previous version of the launcher.
Downloads: Fixed a bug that could cause a new install to overwrite files in another title's existing installation folder.
Downloads: Fixed a bug that could cause previously selected add-ons to be skipped when reinstalling their parent game.
Library: Fixed a bug that could cause a collection to be deleted without asking for confirmation.
EULA prompt: Fixed a bug that could cause the end user license agreement prompt to fail to appear in some cases.
In-app web pages: Fixed a bug that could cause error messages to appear when a page was still loading.
Menus: Fixed a bug that could cause certain menus to overlap the social panel.
Settings: You can now trigger a manual update check next to the version number in Settings > About.
Unreal Engine: Lore and RealityScan Mobile are now grouped under More tools in the Unreal Engine section.
Settings: Fixed a bug that caused download speed units in Settings > Downloads to appear in English regardless of the selected language.
Library: Fixed a bug that could cause add-ons to show an incorrect parent game in the library.
Window controls: Fixed a bug that could cause launcher window content to cover the resize border on some systems.
Library: Games started outside the launcher, such as from a desktop shortcut, are now detected shortly after they start and their playtime is recorded.
Library: Games that start through their own launcher now stay marked as running and keep counting playtime.
Downloads: Fixed a bug that could cause an update to reinstall a game from scratch instead of resuming over an existing older build.
Migration: Fixed a bug that could prevent the previous version of the Epic Games Launcher from being removed during migration if it was still running.
Self-update: Fixed a bug that could cause the launcher's self-update to fail on systems with slower hard drives.
Top bar: The top bar now tells you when it is full or when items have been trimmed to fit.
Library: Fixed a bug that prevented games from appearing in the library's Installed filter while they were still installing.
Sign in: Fixed a bug that could cause the Sign in option in the account menu to not start the sign-in flow.
Uninstall: Fixed a bug that could cause uninstalling an add-on to delete files that the base game still used.
Downloads: Download progress should now display more smoothly on some systems.
Library: Fixed a bug that could cause incorrect installed sizes to be shown in the library.
Library: Fixed a bug that could cause uninstalls to fail when the install directory was temporarily locked.
Unreal Engine: Fixed a bug that could cause engine plugin files to be left behind after removal.
Cloud saves: You can now open a game's save folder directly from the Manage Cloud Saves dialog.
Performance: The launcher now starts faster, with an earlier initial display and smoother navigation right after launch.
Downloads: Fixed a bug that sometimes caused the contents of the pop-out Downloads window to get out of sync with the main window.
Downloads: Fixed a bug that sometimes caused a recently finished download to disappear from the list of recent downloads.
Unreal Engine: Fixed a bug that sometimes prevented engine cards from launching in the Develop tab.
Cloud saves: The launcher can now manage cloud saves for supported games.
Settings: Settings now shows the size of cached data and lets you clear it.
Migration: Fixed a bug that could leave the legacy Epic Games Launcher running while it was being removed during import.
Library: Fixed a bug that caused View in Library to show your Steam and Xbox games alongside the selected game.
Downloads: Fixed several issues that affected the repair, cancel, and install operations.
Fab: Fab can now install code plugins directly into an Unreal Engine installation.
Social: The taskbar badge and system tray icon now reflect your current voice and party status.
Downloads: Fixed a bug that could leave a download stuck in a stale state, and added actions to help recover the download queue when this happens.
Stability: Fixed a bug on macOS where quitting from the menu, Cmd+Q, or the Dock did not fully shut down background services first.
Social: The social panel now plays audio cues for party and voice events on Windows.
Downloads: Fixed a bug that could leave an install stuck at its final verification step with Pause and Cancel unresponsive.
Library: Fixed a bug that disabled the cancel, prioritize, and pause controls on a game's detail dialog while it was queued, updating, or verifying.
Notifications: Fixed a bug that kept notifications from the previously signed-in account on screen after switching to a different account.
Game install: Fixed a bug that caused the Install action on a game's detail page to finish instantly without installing anything.
Partner titles: Fixed a bug that stopped partner-managed titles, such as Ubisoft titles, and their add-ons from installing.
Install options: Fixed a bug that showed a game's install options in English regardless of the currently selected language.
Direct messages: Fixed a bug that left direct-message notifications on screen after the conversation had been read.
